rough: Opener at 820 px portrait: the right column is open between the headline and the photograph until the payoff lands on scroll. A designer may want the photograph to rise higher on tablet.

The opener is one held screen (two seconds by the calibration). The five statements land in the first fifth of the hold; after that the picture pushes slowly and nothing else moves. Reviewers may want more travel.

The opener's standfirst (11 words) and the 46 words on the held stage are above the story rules' caps; defended (see story_check). The owner may prefer shorter first-screen copy; the deck would need to supply it.
Products is long: 4,859 px at 1440 and 6,662 px at 390, with 66 Yes/No cells in the matrix. It is the real catalogue density; a designer may want the families grouped under their jobs instead.
Filtering removes the non-matching rows in one step (the list narrows without a collapse); the new set fades in over 320 ms. Intended; the motion trace records it as a jump and a vanish.
The filter's empty state is built (deck words) but cannot be reached with the current catalogue: every job has at least one family.
Pressing the pressed job again returns to All (a toggle). Chosen so the filter returns to rest; a radio pattern would hold the choice.
Contact success copy from the deck ('A person at Bellis will reply to the email you gave') appears after a local-only submit. The owner should confirm the wording before any real form exists.
The fourth workshop panel (sheet-metal rolling) has no caption in the deck; it carries its alt text only.
No footage anywhere: the owner's rule admits only the client's own pictures and the client supplied no clip (WARN no-footage defended).
The header logo is the supplied raster on a white block at 132 px wide (no vector; no knockout). The footer's 'Bellis' is set as type, not as the logo.
Browser support: :has() needs Chrome 105+; the menu's opening entrance uses @starting-style and display allow-discrete (Chrome 117+); older browsers open the menu without the entrance.
Look scores are from one look round on the rendered pages (critique passes, screenshots only). Round 1 ended at 7.5 to 8.0 by page. No third round was needed: the top items were fixed and re-gated.

findings_for_the_notes.text: A story chapter's useChapterProgress only subscribes when it sits inside the chapter. A parent component that renders StoryChapter gets p = 1 once and never scrubs.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: Call useChapterProgress in the component that renders <StoryChapter>.
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: Render a child component inside the chapter that calls the hook (OpenerScene in home.tsx).

findings_for_the_notes.text: Layout effects of a sibling run before the earlier siblings' refs attach, so a GSAP timeline built on the first progress callback may be built with no targets.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: Build the timeline in the first callback with refs that are set by sibling elements.
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: Guard the build until every target ref is set; build lazily.

findings_for_the_notes.text: The taste gate's reduced-motion check reads a scroll cue that fades to 0 at p 1 as text not shown under reduced motion.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: A scrubbed element that ends at opacity 0.
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: Scrub from a faint start to full opacity so the finished composition shows every word.

findings_for_the_notes.text: The story check counts focusable links inside a closed menu as focus-hidden under visibility:hidden and under aria-hidden/inert.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: A closed mobile menu with visibility:hidden or inert.
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: Close the menu with display:none and animate the open with @starting-style + display allow-discrete.

findings_for_the_notes.text: The taste gate's off-centre rule uses the 98th percentile of text right edges, not the maximum: a table with many short right-hand cells reads as off-centre.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: Products table at 1440 with left-aligned Yes/No cells.

findings_for_the_notes.text: Gate eyebrow rule fires on any short small text stacked above a large figure, including captions on their own figure's baseline.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: Figures list with a caption above the next figure's numeral.
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: Space the rows (96 px) and reorder so no caption is directly above a figure.

findings_for_the_notes.text: The motion trace echoes the whole snippet into its output; large snippets (the craft lint, font audit) must be wrapped in one file per run.
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: Read the saved tool-results file and parse the JSON after the marker.

could_not_verify: Real iOS and Android devices (only Playwright Chrome at 390 wide)
Chrome older than 117 for the menu's entrance (not tested)
Speed-judged feel of the opener's landings (a person should watch it at real speed)
